meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 可以接入 Slack：你可以在 Slack 频道或私信里和它对话；它发出的消息会用 Slack 的 mrkdwn 格式正确显示，而不是变成普通文本。
howto.when: 当用户要求让 Claude 接入 Slack（例如添加频道集成）时触发；技能会引导完成 Slack 应用创建、选择连接方式（Socket 或 Webhook）并配置凭据。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 接进来，让我在频道里和你聊天
say.note: 复制适配器并注册，之后可收发消息。

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 连接我的 Slack 工作区
say.note: 向导引导创建应用并收集 xapp- 令牌。

say.text: 改用 Webhook 方式接收 Slack 事件
say.note: 需要公网 HTTPS 地址，并配置签名密钥。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to Slack: you can talk to it in Slack channels or direct messages, and its messages use Slack's mrkdwn formatting so they render correctly instead of appearing as plain text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to integrate Slack (e.g., add a channel integration). The skill guides you through creating a Slack app, choosing a delivery mode (Socket Mode or webhook), and setting credentials.

say_en.text: Set up Slack so I can chat with you in channels.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and registers it; you can then send and receive messages.

say_en.text: Use Socket Mode to connect my Slack workspace.
say_en.note: Walks through creating the app and collecting the app-level token.

say_en.text: Switch to webhook delivery for Slack events.
say_en.note: Requires a public HTTPS URL; sets the signing secret.
